title: Running Commentary on Torah 48 — Mei Merivas Kadesh
hebrewTitle: פירוש רץ על תורה 48 — מי מריבת קדש
author: Pettek Nanach
methodology: Three-layer line-by-line gloss of the Rebbe's text. Beginner = readable English prose with bracketed translations of every Hebrew/Aramaic term; intermediate = compact bilingual summary with citations; scholarly = terse Hebrew citation list. Two coarse segments preserve Rabbeinu's own ois-structure; each segment unfolds the full aligned_segments content within its span.
